roles.title: Applied AI Engineer (Collaborator, Part-Time)
points: Designed a representative benchmark suite, standardizing 6 public datasets (far speech, ambient noise, accents, mic variation) into one ingest format so evaluation reflects real-world conditions, not clean-audio benchmarks.
Built a plug-and-play interface unifying multiple transcription backends under one manifest, with WER/CER/RTF scoring that enabled evaluation before any domain-specific data was available.
Introduced a local-first benchmarking mode that catches code-level errors without cloud spin-up, saving 1+ hr/week per dev of idle wait — more when GPU provisioning or networks fail.

roles.title: Machine Learning Engineer (Intern)
points: Engineered a recommendation pipeline integrating multi-omics data (gene expression, DepMap) to cluster therapeutic targets and statistically validate drug candidates.
Achieved a 50× runtime reduction in cancer-target discovery via PyTorch GPU vectorization and re-engineered augmentation logic.
Developed a config-driven, data-agnostic analytics dashboard with cached queries and reproducible charts, cutting ad-hoc analysis turnaround from 2–3 days to minutes.
Built SLURM-to-VS Code remote-kernel tooling to replace the legacy Jupyter interface, and ran generative protein-binder discovery (BoltzGen) on self-provisioned AWS EC2 GPU instances.

roles.title: Computer Vision Engineer (Full-Time)
points: Secured a new client by engineering a real-time CPU-only anomaly detection pipeline for pollution monitoring using image processing, clustering, and segmentation.
Achieved 90% recall and 80% precision in content moderation using temporal smoothing; containerized and parallelized the pipeline with Celery and RabbitMQ-based orchestration.
Enabled lag-free ad placement at 30+ FPS with stream-agnostic inference logic; improved tracking throughput by 20× via batching and low-latency pipeline design.
Fine-tuned YOLO-based PPE detection models for company-specific safety gear, hardening them against edge cases and false positives surfaced in manual review.

roles.title: Visiting Student (Intern)
points: Excelled at a rigorous Deep Learning bootcamp at NUS (A+ grade), guiding a 6-person team on construction-site safety detection models.
Trained object detection models from scratch, delivering a working prototype in under a week under tight compute and time limits.

roles.title: AI Researcher (Intern)
points: Led R&D for a team of 5 on AI-powered frame-rate conversion (frame interpolation) for smartphone video quality.
Achieved 27.9 PSNR on 448×256 sequences while exceeding speed and quality KPIs by 1.5×.

roles.title: B.Tech in Computer Science (Specialization in AI/ML)
roles.description: CGPA: 9.06. Focused on AI and ML applications.
roles.subtitle: Academic Projects & Coursework
points: Executed multiple projects spanning app development (React Native), web development (React), networks, and cybersecurity basics.
Implemented core AI architectures across Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Computer Vision, NLP, and Reinforcement Learning.

roles.title: Thesis: Speech Recognition using Reconstructed Phase Spaces
points: Transformed audio signals into 3D phase space representations and applied deep learning for enhanced accuracy.
Built a multilingual ASR pipeline for Indic languages using reconstructed phase spaces as image-like speech representations, reducing error rate from 80% to 30%.
Further reduced error to 15% by combining RPS and MFCC features in a unified deep learning pipeline despite differing feature dimensions.
